prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children enjoying safe exercise, cycling with helmets and a friendly fun run. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Move Together". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Exercise, marathon, fast and slow.
Speed and power, ready for the show.
Bike and helmet, skate and ski.
Recreation, fun for you and the bee.
Partner, member, join the club.
Medal and smile, never stop.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
